scope.project: Floppy Project Interaction System V2 development-control project

reason: The generic FS-12 final-project-closure engine is hard-coded to the provisioned-project .floppy layout. The V2 development-control project intentionally uses Floppy-V2-Project-Plan.* and Floppy-V2-Development-Orchestrator.md instead of legacy root project README/START-HERE/Floppy-D/Floppy-E/roadmap.* records. Final closure therefore requires an explicit layout adapter rather than fabricated legacy files.
execution_rules: V2-05 section closeout TR-008/TR-009 must complete before TR-021.
TR-021 may proceed only when V2-01 through V2-05 are all CLOSED and no work/control authorization or repository writer is active.
TR-021 creates the final-closure record and records the no-migration proposal using the exact seven-path V2 layout above.
TR-022 requires the exact reviewed TR-021 proposal digest and applies final closure using the same exact seven-path V2 layout.
Do not create a next-section draft or V2-06.
Do not mutate reusable main, v2.0.0, the published release, frozen V1 schemas, or accepted historical work-package records except for already-authorized V2-05 closeout state.
The absence of legacy provisioned-project files is not a closure failure for this V2 development-control project and must not be repaired by provisioning them.
